summary: Dock-to-desk equipment migration + temporary badge access for contractor onboarding (Bldg A, 3rd floor)
description:
Issue summary: We need to move a set of docked developer workstations and peripherals from temporary storage to assigned desks for a 2-week contractor engagement. Request includes temporary badge provisioning for contractor, shipments for two spare monitors and one docking station, and pickup/return logistics.

Impact: Contractors cannot start desk-based work until monitors/docks are installed and badge access is granted. This impacts a short-term engagement with a vendor starting 2026-03-02.

Location: Redwood HQ, Building A, 3rd floor (desks 3A-3D). Asset tags referenced in inventory: RW-DEV-2042, RW-MON-3317, RW-MON-3318, RW-DOCK-118.

Requested outcome: Temporary badge active 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-16 for contractor user "contractor.j.smith@vendor.com", monitors and dock delivered and installed on assigned desks by 2026-03-02 morning, and clear return instructions with pre-paid shipping labels for equipment pickup on 2026-03-17.
investigation_notes: 2026-02-28 10:12 - Facilities intake: Received asset list and requested delivery window. Confirmed assets present in facilities storage locker A3.
2026-02-28 14:05 - Security: Temporary badge policy reviewed; can provision 1 L1 contractor badge with floor-level access and timebox. Requires signed NDA and sponsor approval.

2026-03-01 09:30 - IT inventory audit: Verified asset tags: RW-DEV-2042 (laptop with dock), RW-MON-3317, RW-MON-3318. All show last-seen inventory check 2026-02-20. Batteries/cords packed and labeled.
2026-03-01 11:00 - Shipping request: Created FedEx shipment (return) and outbound delivery scheduled for 2026-03-02 08:00. Tracking outbound: 612999999999 (placeholder).
Hypothesis: Delay risk from badge provisioning lead time or failed MFA enrollment. Contingency: Issue temporary QR day-pass and escalate to Security on same-day approval.
Desk map: Confirmed desks 3A-3D have single-power and dual-monitor arms available; need one additional DP->HDMI adapter (IT-OPS to supply).
comments: Aisha Khan (Reporter) - 2026-02-28 10:20: Submitted asset list and contractor contact info. Sponsor: Priya Desai (Engineering manager).
Ben Morales (Assignee, Facilities) - 2026-02-28 13:00: I can pick assets from locker A3 tomorrow morning and coordinate with IT for physical setup. Scheduling shipping for 2026-03-02 08:00.
Evan Liu (Security) - 2026-02-28 14:10: Need signed sponsor approval + contractor gov ID scan before we can issue badge. Requesting confirmation from Priya.
Priya Desai (Sponsor) - 2026-03-01 09:05: Approved. NDA and ID attached (see linked confluence page). Please proceed.
Maya Patel (IT-ops) - 2026-03-01 10:45: Noted: one DP->HDMI adapter missing. Reserving adapter from spare kit; will bring to install.
resolution: In progress: Temporary badge issued (contractor.j.smith@vendor.com) with timebox 2026-03-02 07:00 to 2026-03-16 19:00. Outbound shipment delivered and desks 3A/3B/3C/3D were staged; monitors and dock installed on 2026-03-02 by 09:15. IT confirmed network join and MFA enrollment pending - contractor completed enrollment 2026-03-02 10:05. Return pickup scheduled 2026-03-17 with FedEx tracking 612999999999 (created). Follow-up: perform asset check-in on 2026-03-18 and update inventory. Marking ticket to be closed after return confirmation.
